methods: Compare the E/M/A internal-edge path identities with the frozen symmetry-preserving cycle words.
Check each symbolic edge pair under all 24 colour permutations and both coordinate orientations.
For M-M, verify both cycles each retain three of four edges in the common unused-middle square, for all four orientation pairs.
Compare the set of rule-covered pairs with the complete adjacent-pair set of the existing 72-cycle kernel.
